text: 经国务院批准，近日中国人民银行与阿根廷中央银行续签了双边本币互换协议，互换规模为1300亿元人民币/28万亿阿根廷比索，协议有效期五年，经双方同意可以展期。
text_en: Approved by the State Council, the People's Bank of China recently renewed a bilateral local currency swap agreement with the Central Bank of Argentina, with a swap scale of 130 billion yuan / 28 trillion Argentine pesos, valid for five years and renewable upon mutual consent.
